description: This file defines the EndpointCollectionResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult and handles normalization of collections of API endpoint results in the OrangeHRM system's API v2. It determines whether to normalize a single object or an array of objects based on implemented interfaces.

classes.name: EndpointCollectionResult
classes.description: A class that handles the normalization of a collection of API results, deciding between normalizing a single object or multiple objects depending on their implemented interfaces.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Performs normalization based on whether the model class implements the CollectionNormalizable interface; calls either normalizeObject() or normalizeObjectsArray().
